title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Coordination and Communication in Shared Codebases
abstract: arXiv:2611.00314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents working in shared repositories may receive separate, independently-motivated requests from human developers, creating a setting that is multi-agent by necessity. When this scenario happens, their individual implementations may work separately but conflict when combined. To study this setting, we introduce ParallACT, a benchmark of orchestrator-free multi-agent coding tasks. ParallACT contains both complementary and contradictory tasks. In complementary tasks, each agent's task is separately useful and implementations must share an interface to be productively combined. In contradictory pairs, both agents' tasks require editing the same code in incompatible ways, and naively combining independent solutions fails to produce a useful implementation. translated_title: 共享代码库中的去中心化多智能体协调与通信
translated_abstract: 在共享代码仓库中工作的编程智能体可能会收到来自人类开发者的相互独立、动机各异的请求，从而形成一个必然的多智能体场景。当这种情况发生时，各个智能体的单独实现可能各自可用，但在合并时却会产生冲突。为了研究这一场景，我们提出了 ParallACT，一个无编排器的多智能体编程任务基准。ParallACT 既包含互补任务，也包含矛盾任务。在互补任务中，每个智能体的任务单独来看都有用，且各实现必须共享一个接口才能被有效地结合起来。在矛盾任务对中，两个智能体的任务需要以互不兼容的方式编辑相同的代码，天真地合并独立的解决方案无法产生有用的实现。我们将获得完整合并任务集的单智能体“理想参照”与多种多智能体设置进行比较，这些设置在执行顺序、可见性、对其他智能体的感知以及通信访问等方面有所不同。
tldr: 该论文提出了 ParallACT 基准，首次系统研究无编排器的多个编程智能体在共享代码库中面对互补与矛盾任务时的协调与通信问题，揭示独立开发实现的合并冲突及其影响因素。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ParallACT, a benchmark for studying orchestrator-free coordination among multiple coding agents in shared codebases with complementary and contradictory tasks, revealing conflicts that arise when independently developed implementations are combined.
